quarterly_data.quarter: Nanya Technology press release: Nanya Technology BoD Resolutions (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nanya's board raised 2026 capital expenditure from NT$52.0 billion to up to NT$69.7 billion; the additional budget will be used primarily for advance payments on selected equipment required for the Fab 5A capacity expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 capex raised from NT$52.0 billion to up to NT$69.7 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Nanya Technology press release: Nanya Technology BoD Resolutions (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nanya's board approved Fab 5A capital expenditures of up to NT$346.6 billion for 2026-2029, including EUV equipment, to support a first-phase capacity expansion of 35,900 wafer starts per month (WSPM). The company says Fab 5A is planned with a full capacity of 45,000 WSPM and total capex of approximately US$16 billion, will deploy 10nm-class technology (1C, 1D and 1E) and EUV, and will begin wafer input in the second half of 2027, with capacity expected to ramp to 30,000 WSPM in 2028 and 35,900 WSPM in 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: Fab 5A capex up to NT$346.6 billion (2026-2029); wafer input 2H 2027; 30,000 WSPM in 2028, 35,900 WSPM in 2029; full 45,000 WSPM, ~US$16 billion
